comparison.objective: Feed a captive nut beneath channel lips; candidate breaks and retrieves four HELICOIL tangs from installed coils.
comparison.physical_skill: From the title, constrained nut feeding and under-lip alignment versus coaxial mandrel placement, bimanual impact control, and loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence reports a full-score demo but omits the nut's numeric seating rubric; candidate requires four fractures, retained inserts, and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Even with missing rubric details, constrained insertion/feeding produces an assembled captive nut, whereas the candidate tests controlled sacrificial fracture and removal.
